quote: When this artifact enters, draw a card, then choose a color. This artifact becomes the chosen color.
claim: It is a non-creature artifact, so according to Chulane's text casting it does not trigger the draw-and-land ability.
basis: type line and Chulane's Oracle text

quote: Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)
claim: Linden can attack and still block on the opponent's turn.
basis: Keyword reminder text on the card.

quote: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
claim: Casting Petty Theft (an instant) does not trigger Chulane; casting the creature from exile does.
basis: Chulane's text refers to creature spells; the ruling states an adventurer uses its non-Adventure characteristics except on the stack when not cast as an Adventure, and Petty Theft is an Instant.

interaction: land to hand for Chulane's land trigger
quote: put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand
claim: One basic land enters tapped and one goes to hand, so the hand gets a land for Chulane's trigger.
basis: card text

quote: When this creature enters, draw a card.
claim: According to the card text each time it enters it draws a card, and recasting it also triggers Chulane's cast trigger.
basis: card text

quote: Search your library for an Aura or Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
claim: The card can only find an Aura or Equipment, never a creature.
basis: Card text: search for an Aura or Equipment card.

quote: The source of the damage is Razor Boomerang, not the equipped creature.
claim: The 1 damage comes from the Boomerang, not from the equipped creature.
basis: ruling shown in card block (2010-03-01)

quote: {T}: Add {G}{G}. Activate only if there is an Elf card in your graveyard.
claim: The GG ability works only while an Elf card is in its controller's graveyard.
basis: Card text.

quote: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
claim: The token is created, not cast, so according to the text it does not trigger Chulane.
basis: Chulane text says 'cast'; the token is created by an ability.

quote: Its controller may draw up to two cards at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
claim: The countered spell's controller may draw up to two cards, I draw one.
basis: card text and ruling 2007-09-16

interaction: Ramp into Chulane and creature spells
quote: {T}: Add {C}{C}.
claim: It adds only colourless mana, so it pays generic costs and Chulane's {3} but not coloured pips.
basis: card text

quote: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
claim: Casting this creature triggers Chulane's draw and optional land put, because it is a creature spell cast by you.
basis: Commander text and this card's type line

quote: An adventurer card uses only its non-Adventure characteristics in every zone except the stack, as well as while on the stack if not cast as an Adventure.
claim: On the stack as an Adventure the card is an instant, so it does not count as a creature spell.
basis: Ruling shown in the card block (2025-06-06).

quote: If you don't have a commander, Command Tower's ability produces no mana.
claim: Without a commander, the Tower produces no mana.

quote: Return target nonland permanent an opponent controls to its owner's hand.
claim: Petty Theft can target only a nonland permanent an opponent controls, not one of your own.
basis: card text

quote: This land enters tapped.
claim: The land enters tapped, so it cannot tap for mana on the turn it is played.
basis: Card text: 'This land enters tapped.'

interaction: land drop and Chulane's land put onto the battlefield
quote: This land enters tapped.
claim: According to the card text the land gives no mana on the turn it arrives.
basis: card text

quote: Its controller may draw up to two cards at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
claim: The countered spell's controller may draw up to two cards in the next upkeep.
basis: card text; ruling 2007-09-16 on choosing the number before drawing

quote: Creature — Elf Advisor
claim: It is a creature spell, so casting it is a creature-spell cast for Chulane, according to the type line.
basis: type line

quote: 2010-03-01: Unattaching Razor Boomerang is a cost to activate the equipped creature’s ability.
claim: The unattach is paid as a cost, so the ability always ends with the Equipment unattached.
basis: ruling shown in the card block

quote: A landfall ability triggers whenever a land you control enters for any reason.
claim: Lands put onto the battlefield by Chulane's trigger also fire landfall.
basis: Ruling 2024-11-08 as shown in the card block.

quote: When this creature enters, draw a card.
claim: Each time the creature enters, including after Chulane's bounce and recast, you draw a card.
basis: Card text, with Chulane's bounce text: 'Return target creature you control to its owner's hand.'

interaction: enters-the-battlefield trigger and Chulane bounce replay
quote: When this creature enters, counter target artifact or creature spell.
claim: Each time it enters, the trigger counters a target artifact or creature spell; a replay after Chulane's bounce triggers it again.
basis: card text: the trigger is on entering the battlefield

interaction: Chulane's colour identity is green, white and blue.
quote: {T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.
claim: The land taps for G, W or U as needed, as long as the deck has its commander available as the identity source.
basis: card text; rulings shown say it produces no mana only without a commander or with a colourless identity

quote: This land enters tapped.
claim: It produces no mana on the turn it is played.
basis: Card text

interaction: Card draw from the Jace token
quote: Empower Jace 4. (Put four loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[−1]: Surveil 1" and "[−3]: Draw a card.")
claim: According to the card text, the token starts with four loyalty and can use -3 to draw a card, then -1 to surveil.
basis: Reminder text of Empower Jace in the card block.

quote: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
claim: The spell can be cast with no target and does not trigger Chulane's cast ability.
basis: card text ('up to one') and Chulane text ('cast a creature spell')

quote: When this creature enters, you gain 3 life.
claim: Returning and recasting it gives another 3 life and another Chulane cast trigger.
basis: Card text is a plain ETB; recasting a creature spell triggers Chulane.

interaction: Chulane's cast trigger putting a land from hand
quote: When this land enters, return a land you control to its owner's hand.
claim: The returned land is a land card in hand that Chulane's trigger can put onto the battlefield after a creature spell is cast.
basis: Chulane's text: you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield; the bounce puts a land card in hand.

quote: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn.
claim: It prevents damage to you and your creatures for the rest of this turn only, not on other turns.
basis: card text: 'this turn'

quote: detain target creature an opponent controls. (Until your next turn, that creature can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated.)
claim: The detained creature is restricted only until my next turn.
basis: card text

quote: This creature enters prepared.
claim: Each time the Fateseer re-enters, it becomes prepared again.
basis: Card text: the enters-prepared effect applies whenever the creature enters.

interaction: Narset's dig with a creature-heavy deck
quote: You may reveal a noncreature, nonland card from among them and put it into your hand.
claim: According to the card text creatures and lands cannot be taken, so the dig misses most of this deck.
basis: card text

quote: When this artifact enters, draw a card, then choose a color.
claim: Puca's Eye draws one card when it enters.
basis: Card text.

quote: When this creature enters, you gain 3 life.
claim: According to the card text and Chulane's {3},{T} ability, returning and recasting it gains 3 life again and triggers Chulane again.
basis: card text and Chulane's Oracle text

interaction: Arbor Elf cast versus Chulane's trigger
quote: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
claim: Casting Arbor Elf triggers Chulane, since it is a creature spell cast from hand or by Chulane's replay.
basis: commander card text

quote: As an additional cost to cast this spell, behold an Elf or pay {2}.
claim: Without an Elf to behold, the spell costs {2} more, so in a normal game it costs four mana.
basis: card text

interaction: Triggers on any entering creature with power 5 or more, cast or not.
quote: Whenever a creature you control with power 5 or greater enters, you may put two +1/+1 counters on it.
claim: A big creature replayed with Chulane's bounce triggers it again each time it enters.
basis: card text: it says 'enters', not 'cast'

quote: Creature — Elemental
claim: Casting it is a creature spell cast, so it triggers Chulane's draw.
basis: Type line Creature; Chulane triggers on casting a creature spell.

quote: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
claim: The fetched basic enters tapped.
basis: Card text.
